knowledge_geography.name: Knowledge (Geography)
knowledge_geography.synergyNotes: 5+ ranks in Knowledge (geography) grants a +2 synergy bonus on Survival checks made to keep from getting lost or for natural hazard avoidance.

actions.name: Recall Topography and Terrestrial Features
actions.description: Recall regional terrain, climate bands, major river basins, trade pathways, and cartographic settlements.
